content.title: Help!
content.text:
This is a place to have help and or tips about things in game.

How to claim starter kit:
1. press F6
2. click "kits" tab
3. click on "starter kit" and click redeem
4. click "redeem kits" tab
5. click "use kit" & items will spawn in your inventory
(All kits work like this)

These servers are a cluster, change servers at the obelisk.
Maps include The Island, Scorched Earth, Aberration, Extinction & Ragnarok.

.
